channel.title: Cote d'Ivoire - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Cote d'Ivoire, every source cited.

item.title: Ivory Coast police launch operation Epervier 12
item.description: The operation aims to dismantle criminal networks across the nation.

item.title: Ivory Coast mobilizes 4 billion FCFA for mental health
item.description: Minister Pierre N’Gou Dimba announced the funds for 2027 at a multisectoral dialogue on mental health.

item.title: Ivory Coast simulates major cyberattack
item.description: 800 participants from energy, telecoms, and finance faced a fictional digital crisis in Abidjan.

item.title: Ivory Coast trains 26 experts on Chemical Weapons protection
item.description: Specialists from 14 francophone nations are learning detection, decontamination, and victim care at the AILCT.

item.title: Abidjan hospital performs three arterial surgeries
item.description: Institut Cœur de Grâce uses a hybrid operating room and French specialists to treat vascular conditions and train local doctors.
